_meta.purpose: AI image generation prompts for shot placement diagrams on each species page. One image per species: animal in broadside view with a single target marking ideal vitals. Replace Shot Placement placeholders in app/[species]/page.tsx.
_meta.constraints: No text, no labels, no text overlays. Uniform style across all species.
_meta.shotPlacementFact: For all species the ideal broadside shot is: one-third of the way up the body, just behind the front leg (heart and lungs). Diagram shows this single aim point only.

uniformStyleSpec.description: Use this exact style for every species so all images look like one set.
uniformStyleSpec.style: Clean technical illustration or diagram. Single animal in broadside view (side profile), standing or walking. One clear aim-point marker: a circle or crosshair or shaded oval on the chest, positioned one-third of the way up from the belly line, just behind the front leg. No text. No labels. No words. Minimal or no background; neutral flat colour or very subtle gradient only.
uniformStyleSpec.visual: Line art or soft diagrammatic illustration. Consistent line weight. Animal recognizable but simplified enough to read as a diagram. Target marker: single colour (e.g. red circle, or dark grey crosshair), same style across all images. No blood, no gore, no graphic detail.
uniformStyleSpec.negativePrompt: Text, letters, words, labels, captions, numbers, arrows with text. Photorealistic. Cartoon. Cute. Multiple animals. Different style from the others. Cluttered background. Blood, gore.
